name: Matrixdock Silver
oneLiner: XAGm is Matrixdock's silver-backed commodity token, with each token representing roughly one troy ounce of LBMA Good Delivery silver vaulted in Asia.
collateral: LBMA-accredited 99.9% Good Delivery silver bars held in Asian vaults under Matrixdock's fractional-reserve-safeguard framework
pegMechanism: Silver-backed commodity token redeemable through Matrixdock for KYC-approved users; issuer materials expose supply, bullion weight, and an oz-per-token metric that may drift slightly from exactly one ounce

proofOfReserves.provider: Bureau Veritas (XAGm silver first entered the semi-annual Matrixdock audit programme with the July 2026 cycle — one XAGm audit to date, so no recurring cadence is claimed; certificate hosted on Matrixdock's GitBook, not matrixdock.com)

latestReport.reviewer: PoR remediation pass 2026-08 (PDF read directly: 100% physical audit of 508 gold and 66 silver bars against the Parcel Ownership List dated 30 June 2026 at Brink's HK/SG and Malca-Amit SG, no anomalies; no token-liability reconciliation performed)

params.label: Physical silver bars (LBMA Good Delivery, Asian vault custody)

notices.title: Dynamic silver-per-token metric
notices.message: Matrixdock publishes an ozPerToken figure for XAGm, so the Pharos silver-ounce reference uses 1 oz while reserve review should watch the issuer's live metric.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XAGm is a direct allocated-commodity claim on silver: Matrixdock discloses LBMA Good Delivery silver backing with live token-supply-versus-bullion accounting, and the July 2026 Bureau Veritas certificate independently inspected all 66 XAGm silver bars at Brink's Hong Kong, Brink's Singapore, and Malca-Amit Singapore as of 2026-06-30 with no anomalies. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14; the owner ruling scopes the archetype to all direct commodity claims, silver included.
